facility.name: Little Steps Montessori
facility.programs_provided: After School Care,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The director did not have proof of current training in pediatric CPR. The previous training expired in 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: Safety documentation for monthly checks of fire extinguishers, carbon monoxide detectors and smoke detectors was not current. The equipment was last checked in August 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The director did not have proof of current training in pediatric first aid training. The previous training expired in 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The backyard had three areas in the fence where slats were loose at the bottom of the fence and nails were exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File: During the follow up inspection, the operation did not have an emergency evacuation and relocation diagram on file or posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File (26 TAC §747.5007)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: During the follow up inspection, it was found that the caregiver had not completed half of the required annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The operation has no record of testing or changing the batteries in the smoke detectors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Kept Sanitary: During the inspection, the flexible gauze in the first aid kit had grass on it and the scissors were rusty and the scissor blade had an unknown dark substance on it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Kept Sanitary (26 TAC §747.3801(2))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: During the inspection the operator could not provide her current certification for CPR or first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The caregiver had not completed any of the required annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The operation has not been doing any monthly checks on the fire extinguisher at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §747.5107(a))

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Documentation Available During Hours of Operation: The operation has no record of testing or changing the batteries in the carbon monoxide detectors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Documentation Available During Hours of Operation (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File: The operation did not have an emergency evacuation and relocation diagram on file or posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File (26 TAC §747.5007)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: At the time of the follow up inspection the operational policies had not been updated. The provider was unable to locate any policies during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: At the time of the follow up inspection the provider had 10 training hours that could be counted towards this current year of training. She is still missing 20 hours of training that should have been completed last year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The provider had not yet updated the CPSC form at the time of the follow up inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: At the time of the follow up inspection the provider had still not completed any of the annual training hour requirements. No trainings were available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The provider had not yet updated the CPSC form at the time of the follow up inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Antiseptic solutions or wipes: No antiseptic solutions and/or ointments were stiill not present in the first aid kit at the time of the follow up inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Antiseptic solutions or wipes (26 TAC §747.3803(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: At the time of the follow up visit, the provider had not installed a smoke detector near the main care room in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies reviewed during this time were not for a child care home and had not been updated as needed. At the time of the follow up inspection the operational policies had not been updated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The provider had not posted the most recent inspection form even following the visit in August 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: At the time of inspection the provider did not have any training hours from the previous full year. The last training certificates were from the year 2022.  Provider request time to get the training completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: At the time of the inspection that provider's most recent posted inspection was from 2019. She was unable to locate a copy of the inspection that was sent to her last year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Antiseptic solutions or wipes: No antiseptic solutions and/or ointments were present in the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Antiseptic solutions or wipes (26 TAC §747.3803(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The last time the annual certification was completed was back in 2019. This was the date on the form posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies reviewed during this time were not for a child care home and had not been updated as needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: The main care room did not have a smoke detector present. The closet smoke detector was in one of the bedrooms of the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)

occurrences.finding: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: It was observed  rusty nails protruding out of the wooden fence surrounding the backyard area, at the children's level.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Three of the four children records reviewed were missing  current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months: The primary caregiver was missing annual training in safe sleep techniques.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months (26 TAC §747.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary caregiver was missing training in pediatric first-aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The primary caregiver was missing training in pediatric CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver has completed 8 of the 30 hours of required annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Cleaning supplies in the bathroom were observed within arms  reach of children.  Note: This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The emergency preparedness plan was missing a statement regarding how the operation will continue caring for children until each children has been released, and how will reunify the children with the parents as the evacuation, relocation or sheltering is lifted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The primary caregiver was missing  annual training in the health and safety topics: emergency preparedness plan, preventing communicable diseases, administering medication, handling, disposing hazards materials, responding to food allergies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: One child needs the required health statement.  There was no signed statement from a health caregiver professional or a statement from the parent that the chld had been seen in the last year and would provide that health care professional's statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One child in care needs an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §747.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An eleven month old child was observed sleeping in a swing.  A sleep exception form was not file for the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2326)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Feeding insturctions are not on file for one infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §747.2321(b))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver did not complete the required 30 hours in her last training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))
